'''Ipsidon'''<ref name="Michelle Ang">{{SW|url=news/michelle-ang-interview-the-bad-batch-season-2|text=Soldier and Survivor: Michelle Ang on Omega's Story in ''Star Wars: The Bad Batch''}}</ref> was a remote [[planet]]<ref name="223 S2 Guide">{{InsiderCite|223|Star Wars: The Bad Batch Season Two Companion|''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'' Season Two Companion}}</ref> home to violent [[sandstorm]]s that could occur creating lightning and provoking the [[Ipsidon buck|Ibisidon bucks]] into stampeding through its canyons.<ref name="Crossing" /> During or after [[18 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TBBDate|209}}</ref> the mercenary squad [[Clone Force 99]] became stranded on Ipsidon during a mission to extract [[ipsium]] from a [[Cid's mine|mine]] owned by [[Ciddarin Scaleback]], during which the [[thief]] and [[miner]] [[Benni Baro]] stole their [[starship]], the [[Marauder (Omicron-class)|''Marauder'']].<ref name="Crossing" /> They were able to reclaim it by tracking their [[GNK-series power droid]], [[Gonky (Clone Force 99)|Gonky]], who was left aboard.<ref name="Retrieval" />

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Ipsidon first appeared in "[[The Crossing]]," the ninth episode of ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]''{{'s}} [[The Bad Batch Season 2|second season]], which premiered on [[Disney+]] on [[February 15]], [[2023]].<ref name="Crossing" />
